Manx: shenn jacob un laa myr ve toollit as skee
English: old jacob when tired and weary one day

Manx: lesh clagh fo e chione lhie eh sheese ec yn oie
English: with a stone for his pillow at night down he lay

Manx: ayns shen ren eh dreamal jeh aarey ec laue
English: and there he did dream of a ladder close by

Manx: ve soit er y thalloo as roshtyn gys niau
English: it was set on the ground and did reach for the sky

Manx: ta'n aarey foast fondagh gyn brishey erbee
English: the ladder is sound without any break

Manx: thou saneyn dy vleeantyn goaill sleih seose gys jee
English: for thousands of years to god doth souls take

Manx: thou saneyn ayns shen ta ec kione nyn yurnaa
English: and thousands whose journey is ended are there

Manx: as jeihghyn thousane chionney seose er dagh laa
English: and ten thousand daily to get up prepare

Manx: shiuish ooilley ta kiarit dy chosney gys niau
English: all you who determined are heaven to ascend

Manx: gys yeesey nyn garrey ec keayrt tar shiu reue
English: at once come to jesus for he is your friend

Manx: ec mullagh yn aarey te farkiaght dagh laa
English: at the top of the ladder he daily doth wait

Manx: as nane cha bee treigit hig huggey ayns traa
English: and no one who comes to him will he forsake

Manx: goll seose ayns yn laa's tuittym back ayns yn oie
English: going up in the day at night falling away

Manx: te jannoo yn jurnaa dy deinagh as dree
English: will make the road tedious and cause irksome delay

Manx: nagh lhig dooin ve liastey ny skee jannoo mie
English: do not let us be slothful but good work get done

Manx: ta'n leagh dy chooilleeney nyn gour ec y thie
English: the reward will be given when we arrive home

Manx: shiuish ooilley ta beaghey meerooisagh dagh laa
English: all you who are wantomly spending the time

Manx: gys niau fegooish aarey cha jig shiu dy braa
English: without a ladder to heaven you never can climb

Manx: bee'n aarey chelleeragh veih'n ooir tayrnit seose
English: the ladder may quickly be drawn up you know

Manx: myr brelleein yn noo peddyr as c'raad hig shiu eisht
English: like the sheet of saint peter - then where will you go

Manx: nish roish my bee'n laa dy haualtys ec kione
English: now in time lest the day of salvation pass o'er

Manx: lhig dooin chionney geiyrt er nyn gaarjyn hie roin
English: let us earnestly follow the friends gone before

Manx: ayns nyn eiraght maynrey dy yoinal ad reesht
English: to that happy inheritance and join them again

Manx: sy voayl nee ad reill son dy bragh marish chreest
English: in that place where with christ they for ever will reign

Manx: bee lught thie nyn mraaraghyn ooilley ayns shen
English: our brethren and families they too will be there

Manx: as ooilley ny nooghyn va ain orroo enn
English: and all of the saints that we knew when down here

Manx: cre'n yennallys anmey cre'n voggey erskyn insh
English: what pleasure of soul what ineffable joy

Manx: vees ain ayns ny niauaghyn tra veeitys mayd reesht
English: we will have when we meet them again in the sky

Manx: ayns shen baillym fakin my voir as my ayr
English: it would please me my mother and father to see

Manx: gerjoil marish yeesey ass roshtyn dangeyr
English: comforted with jesus from all danger free

Manx: as maynrey vees adsyn nee paagey nyn gloan
English: and they will be happy their children to kiss

Manx: ayns niau raad vees ooilley nyn droailtys ec kione
English: their toiling all ended in that heaven of bliss

Manx: aigh vie lhieu my chaarjyn as braaraghyn deyr
English: best wishes to friends and my brethren dear

Manx: as ooilley my huyraghyn wass fo yn aer
English: and to each of my sisters who still are down here

Manx: as reesht lhig dou fakin shiu ooilley dy mie
English: but again may i see you where all will be well

Manx: yn laa vees ny nooghyn gys gloyr er jeet thie
English: when the saints have come home into glory to dwell

Manx: ayns shen cha bee skeaylley ny scarrey ny smoo
English: in that place no dividing no parting no sin

Manx: agh giu stiagh gyn jerrey yn vaynrys t'ayns niau
English: heaven's happiness ever will be drinking in

Manx: ard ghloyr as ard voylley gys jee as yn eayn
English: high glory and praise be to god and the lamb

Manx: son dy bragh as dy bragh halleluia amen
English: for ever and ever - halleluia amen
